notes: Same text as the 2023 twin (an elementary item or a level 1 group item, in the file, working-storage, local-storage or linkage section; a level-66 alias is neither). COBOL 2002's communication section is the fifth data section the list omits: ExpandSameAsEntry refuses a target whose root's DataItem.Section is EntrySection.Communication (COBOL1556, citing §2002:13.16.47.2 SR7), so a CD record item or the CD's own interface area is no SAME AS target, while a working-storage target copied into a CD record is legal (pb5606-same-as-section-list). kb/Work PB5606.
